reasoning: Test image shows soybean stems split lengthwise with clearly brown/reddish-brown internal pith discoloration and normal-appearing external cortex. This is the definitive diagnostic feature of Brown Stem Rot — split stems revealing brown pith. SDS (the main differential) produces white pith, not brown. Charcoal Rot and Phytophthora affect the external stem surface rather than showing internal pith browning in this manner.
